svg.title: GenericSuite — general architecture for end users
svg.desc: JSON configuration files defining menus, database schemas, input forms, API endpoints and authorization feed the GenericSuite core, which produces a React web frontend, Flutter mobile and desktop apps, a Python backend API and an MCP server, running on major databases, AI providers and clouds.
svg.text: GenericSuite — How It All Fits Together
Define your application once in JSON. Get web, mobile, backend API and MCP services out — ready to deploy and scale.
Edit a file → every layer follows
Admin UI, CRUD screens, forms & menus
Exposes your app as tools for AI agents
swap engines without touching your config
Lambda · Fargate · Cloud Run · App Service · Docker · S3 / CloudFront static hosting

g.text: runtime calls between your app's own services

svg.text: One JSON config → web + mobile + API + MCP,
on the database, cloud and AI provider of your choice.
